releaseNotes: v5.1.10 — Point 1, Quick Add pips-first: SL pips and TP pips boxes sit next to the SL/TP prices ($1 = 10 pips). Type prices and the pips fill themselves; type pips and the price is set from the entry (buy or sell). SL/TP pips are saved on the trade and shown in the Trades table and CSV export. Quick Add is now minimal — almost no text inside it; the full explanation (with a worked example) lives in the How to Use tab. Smooth focus glow and pop animations, all themes. Everything from v5.1.9 unchanged, including the permanent updater helper.
